meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过调研、引用和实时反馈提升写作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成高质量文章或内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Improve writing quality with research, citations, and real-time feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce high-quality articles or content efficiently

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成你的写作搭档:帮你搭大纲、查资料并补引用、优化开头钩子、逐段给反馈,同时保持你原本的文风。写作从独自进行变成协作推进。
howto.when: 当你写博客、文章、教程等,或提出查资料补引用、优化开头钩子、逐段反馈等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我为「AI 如何改变产品经理工作」写一份文章大纲
say.note: 它会先问清主题、受众和风格,再一起搭大纲。

say.text: 查一下 AI 影响产品管理的最新数据,加上引用放进大纲
say.note: 它会整理关键数据、专家引语和规范化引用。

say.text: 这是我写的开头,帮我让钩子更有吸引力
say.note: 它会分析现有钩子并给出多个改写方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a writing partner: it helps structure outlines, researches topics and adds citations, strengthens hooks, gives section-by-section feedback, and preserves the user's own voice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing blog posts, articles, tutorials, etc., or when requesting research, citations, hook improvement, or section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about AI's impact on productivity.
say_en.note: Asks clarifying questions, then co-builds the outline.

say_en.text: Find recent data on AI in product management and add citations to my outline.
say_en.note: Claude gathers data, quotes, and formatted citations.

say_en.text: Here is my introduction. Help me make the hook more compelling.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the hook and offers alternatives.
